name.baseName: Disposal, lignite ash, 0% water, to opencast refill

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Ash composition calculated from country-specific coal composition (DE) and technology-specific transfer coefficients in power plant.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Lignite ash as backfill in lignite opencast mine (together with tailings)

# Included processes
This module contains only direct emissions from lignite ash used as backfill in opencast lignite mines: short-term emissions (0-100a) and long-term emissions (>100a) both to ground water. E.g. land-use and energy consumption is *not* included.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: country-specific calculation based on literature data

review.common:reviewDetails: Proof reading validation: passed.; Other validation: none;

publicationAndOwnership.common:accessRestrictions: All information can be accessed by everybody.
